notes.title: September 5, 2025 《PAGUI》Update Announcement
notes.notes:
《PAGUI》Update Announcement
Dear Players,
Thank you for your enthusiastic support for PAGUI! Based on player feedback, we’ve released this update, including balance adjustments, bug fixes, and new features to enhance the combat experience and game stability. Below are the detailed update notes:
Balance Adjustments
Character Technique Unyielding Adjustment: Balanced the Unyielding values of character Techniques to improve combat fairness.
Fate Tablet "Late Roll Call" Adjustment: Increased the damage effect of the Fate Tablet Late Roll Call.
Fate Tablet "Fundamentals" Adjustment: Reduced the boost value of the Fate Tablet Fundamentals to optimize balance.
Malevolent Frenzy Qi Adjustment: Adjusted the amount of Malevolent Qi required for The Malevolent to enter Frenzy levels.
Spit Toad Behavior Adjustment: Spit Toad’s behavior is now more flexible and unpredictable, increasing its challenge.
Minxiong Haunted House Scene Adjustment: The Minxiong Haunted House map now features varied environmental changes each time it’s entered.
New Features
Trinket Removal Function: Players can now click equipped Trinkets to remove them, increasing equipment flexibility.
Bug Fixes
Talent Fix: Fixed an issue where the talent Banish Abroad allowed interaction with The Malevolent’s escape gate.
Game Crash Fix: Resolved a crash issue caused by using Lost Souls instantly during Frenzy.
HP Bar Display Fix: Corrected an issue where The Malevolent and Fiends displayed incorrect HP bars upon spawning.
Death Ward Fix: Fixed an issue where, after triggering the Fate Tablet Death Ward, players outside the Supreme Water Array range of the Evil Taoist Priest still took damage.
PAGUI Development Team
September 5, 2025

《PAGUI》Update Announcement

August 7, 2025

notes.title: 《PAGUI》Update Announcement July 10, 2025
notes.notes:
《PAGUI》Update Announcement
Dear Players,
Thank you for your continued support for PAGUI! Based on player feedback, we’ve released this update, featuring balance adjustments, map optimizations, and various gameplay improvements to enhance combat fluidity and overall enjoyment. Below are the detailed update notes:
Balance Adjustments
Malevolent Sprint Speed Adjustment: Increased base sprint speed for Corrupted Galan and Evil Taoist Priest, reduced for Hanged Man.
Corrupted Galan HP Adjustment: Increased Corrupted Galan’s Max HP.
Corrupted Galan Frenzy Spell Adjustment: Increased damage of Corrupted Galan’s Frenzy Spells.
Evil Taoist Priest Talisman Adjustment: Increased talisman damage, affecting the Technique Talisman Volley and Frenzy Spell Spectral Talisman Swarm.
Wind Lion Cooldown Adjustment: Increased Wind Lion’s cooldown from 20 seconds to 30 seconds.
Body Protection Effect Adjustment: Reduced the duration of Body Protection I and Body Protection II from 10 seconds to 8 seconds.
SP Recovery Adjustment: SP no longer recovers during jumps.
Huo-Wang Technique Adjustment: Reduced the dash distance and damage of Huo-Wang’s Technique Blade Wheel Slash.
Huo-Wang Technique Optimization: Increased the speed of Huo-Wang’s Technique Solar Flare Crescent.
Huo-Wang Talent Adjustment: Balanced the values of Huo-Wang’s talent Seamless Flow.
Huo-Wang Talent Adjustment: Balanced the values of Huo-Wang’s talent Battle-Honed.
Map Adjustments
Chiayi Station Changes: Adjusted the terrain of Chiayi Station during the Frenzy phase.
Optimizations
Ambush Imps Casting Optimization: Improved the casting process of Ambush Imps, ensuring target selection is no longer blocked by other Shrines.
Recall Banner Visual Effect Addition: Added a visual effect upon teleporting to a Recall Banner’s destination.
Trap Collision Adjustment: Optimized trap collision detection, making it harder for The Exorcists to avoid triggering traps via jumping.
Corrupted Galan Sound Adjustment: Reduced the volume of Corrupted Galan’s footstep sound.
Teammate Disconnect Compensation Mechanism: Added a compensation mechanism for when an Exorcist teammate leaves, distributing boosts to remaining teammates based on the departing player’s Fate Tablets, including increased Max SP, enhanced SP recovery speed, faster Exorcism Chant speed, and the ability to draw a new Fate Tablet.
PAGUI Development Team
July 10, 2025

notes.title: 《PAGUI》Update Announcement July 8, 2025
notes.notes:
《PAGUI》Update Announcement
Dear Players,
Thank you for your enthusiastic support for PAGUI! Based on player feedback, we’ve released this update, which includes multiple bug fixes and balance adjustments to enhance game stability and combat experience. Below are the detailed update notes:

Balance Adjustments
Recall Banner Teleport Notification: Added a notification to alert players when a Recall Banner teleport fails.
Recall Banner Preparation Time: Significantly increased the preparation time after placing a Recall Banner.
Tsui-Lin Weapon Adjustment: Increased the attack speed of Tsui-Lin’s Life-Return Blade and Breath-Return Blade.
Regeneration II Effect Adjustment: Reduced Regeneration II’s effect from restoring 5 HP per second to 3 HP per second.
Evil Taoist Priest Frenzy Spell Adjustment: Increased the damage of the Evil Taoist Priest’s Frenzy Spell Supreme Water Array.
Hanged Man Sound Effect Addition: Added a wind-blowing sound effect to Hanged Man’s movement to enhance immersion.
Frenzy Map Effect: After entering Frenzy, Paper Planes will scatter across the map.
Item Usage Optimization: Feng Shui Compass and Paper Plane will not be consumed if no target is found.
Unyielding Effect Enhancement: During the Unyielding effect, added immunity to Stun and Hanged effects.
Hanged Man Talent Restriction: While the Hanged Man’s talent Shrine Lockdown is active, teleporting Lost Souls cannot be used.
Hanged Man Noose Adjustment: Reduced the accumulation speed of Hanged Man’s Noose.

Bug Fixes
Level-Up Animation Fix: Fixed an issue where the account level-up animation failed to display after a match, ensuring proper playback.
Swap Effigy Bug Fix: Resolved an issue where Swap Effigy caused The Exorcists to be unable to attack or use Artifacts after teleportation.
Trap Trigger Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where all traps could be triggered instantly by humans upon placement, now restoring the intended preparation time.

PAGUI Development Team
July 8, 2025

notes.title: （PAGUI）Update Announcement July 7, 2025
notes.notes:
（PAGUI）Update Announcement
Dear Players,
Thank you for your continued support for PAGUI! We’ve listened to your valuable feedback and are excited to release this update, which includes gameplay balance adjustments and multiple bug fixes. Below are the detailed update notes:
Balance Adjustments
Recall Banner Cooldown Adjustment: Reduced the cooldown for placing a Recall Banner to 10 seconds. After triggering the teleport effect, the Artifact enters a 45-second cooldown.
False Shrine Broadcast: False Shrines now trigger a field-wide announcement upon spawning, notifying all players.
Fate Tablet Adjustment: The effect of the Fate Tablet Wraith’s Wrath now inflicts Burn II instead of its previous setting when performing Soul Reave.
Spit Toad Malevolent Qi Adjustment: Reduced the amount of Malevolent Qi gained from successful Spit Toad attacks.
Skeletal Grasp Malevolent Qi Adjustment: Reduced the amount of Malevolent Qi gained when Skeletal Grasp is triggered.
Red Lost Souls Lock Duration: Added a maximum duration limit to the Shrine Lock effect triggered by Red Lost Souls.
Malevolent Fate Tablet Probability Adjustment: Adjusted the draw probability of The Malevolent’s Fate Tablets to optimize game balance.
Tsui-Lin Stats Adjustment: Increased Tsui-Lin’s base stats, allowing her to withstand more damage.
Bug Fixes
Evil Taoist Priest Talent Fix: Resolved an issue with the damage calculation of the Evil Taoist Priest’s talent Piercing Skybeams: Spiral, ensuring proper effect activation.
Frenzy Phase Issue Fix: Fixed a bug where being instantly killed upon entering Frenzy could result in Soul Shattered.
Hanged Man Talent Fix: Corrected an issue where the Hanged Man’s talent Shrine Lockdown caused permanent Revelation upon entering Frenzy.
Frenzy Spell Execution Issue: Fixed a bug where active Frenzy Spells failed to function properly after a temporary Frenzy state ended.
Spit Toad Limit Fix: Resolved an issue where the placement limit for Spit Toad was not enforced, ensuring proper restriction execution.
PAGUI Development Team


July 7, 2025

notes.title: （PAGUI）Update Announcement 2025/7/4
notes.notes:
《打鬼》（PAGUI）Update Announcement
Dear Players,
Thank you for your enthusiastic support for PAGUI! Based on player feedback, we’ve rolled out this update, featuring gameplay balance adjustments and multiple bug fixes to enhance combat experience and game stability. Below are the detailed update notes:
Balance Adjustments
Malevolent Frenzy Adjustments
Reduced The Malevolent’s SP recovery speed and sprint speed during Frenzy, providing The Exorcists with more opportunities to deal damage.
Artifact Cooldown Adjustments
Veil Mirror cooldown increased from 45 seconds to 55 seconds.
Bunny-Shaped Pendant cooldown increased from 30 seconds to 35 seconds.
Ambush Imps cooldown increased from 60 seconds to 70 seconds.
Recall Banner cooldown increased from 10 seconds to 15 seconds.
Fiend HP Adjustments
Scorpion Fiend Max HP reduced by 10 points.
Skeleton Max HP reduced by 5 points.
Hanged Man Frenzy Spell Adjustments
Wail of Malice cooldown increased from 15 seconds to 20 seconds.
Corpse Toxin Burst cooldown increased from 30 seconds to 45 seconds.
Soul Reave Malevolent Qi Adjustments
Slightly reduced the amount of Malevolent Qi gained from Soul Reave.
Shrine Restoration Talent Adjustment
Evil Taoist Priest’s Shrine Restoration talent activation time adjusted to 45 seconds.
Red Lost Souls Adjustments
Reduced the maximum number of Red Lost Souls present.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the inventory would not appear at the start of a match, ensuring proper item usage.
Resolved a bug preventing players from exiting the Exorcism Chant perspective in certain cases.
Fixed an issue where manually drawing a Fate Tablet resulted in a blank page that could not be exited.
Corrected a bug where Red Lost Souls occasionally failed to enter a dispellable state after activation.
Fixed a visual issue where Hanged Man’s eyes remained visible during Invisibility.
Resolved an issue where Inventory Seal items dropped upon human death and could be picked up by teammates.
Fixed certain Fate Tablets not functioning correctly in specific scenarios.
Addressed a crash issue when entering the Tutorial Level in some cases.
Corrected several translation errors.
PAGUI Development Team


July 4, 2025

notes.title: Official Exclusive Premiere PAGUI "open the sun "Hidden version released
notes.notes: Turn on the sun, the flesh and blood juice machine, when I heard this song, the picture of the animation was already rolling in my mind, and I had goosebumps on the spot, until a year after the animation was made, when I passed it on to my colleagues, they all responded quietly , nothing happened. I thought I was just being self-indulgent? Until the game was launched, although it was the first work of Hakka spirit in the fledgling period, there were a lot of problems and negative reviews, but this animation attracted everyone's attention, and the breath of funds and money were burned here. The reviews of one part also brought back some good reviews. Seeing that everyone likes this passage so much, I will release the "hidden version" that outsiders can't see, and make a perfect ending for this year. The new year is coming, and the ghost-fighting universe will continue to bloom. I wish you all a happy new year.
